scope: Body/bones/animation/attachment interfaces only; no held object or armor production
initial_body: 19 AdvancedModelBox fields, 18 addBox calls, 18 parent edges; root carries no cuboid. getAllParts enumerates all19; parts renders root.
root [0,24,0] -> body [0,-15,4]; body10x11x13, chest8x9x9 rotates10deg, neck4x11x5 -> head5x4x6 -> snout3x3x4; ears thin3x6x1.
Both support chains body -> leg -> knee -> foot, thigh3x7x8, knee2x9x3, foot3x2x12. Tail5x6x15 ->3x4x15 originates rear body; neither hands nor snout are paw contact solvers.
Body/pouch/chest/neck/head form connected hierarchies; this is nonhuman anatomy despite two rear support limbs. Static shape is already credited, not new reference count.
layer_order: setupAnim calls animate: resetToDefaultPose then animator.update then four animation definitions. Afterwards interpolates sit/pouch/move/stand counters.
stillProgress=max(0, interpolatedStand-interpolatedMoving); water AI may directly reset totalMovingProgress=0. VisualFlag1 arm spread applied before sit/still overlays.
Sitting fold: knee+65deg, foot-65deg; body+7Y, arm shifts[-4.5Y,+2Z], feet[-1Y,+.7Z]. Stand raises/rears body-35deg and counters thighs+35deg, chest-10deg, neck+35deg, tail+25deg each.
Then perpetual idle arm/chest/neck/tail/ears, then jump sin(pi*completion) body lift/leg/knee/foot offsets/rotations; late foot push uses max(0,jumpRotation-.5)*25deg.
Then helmet folds ears +/-75deg, occupied dominant hand armX-25deg; head yaw .35/head pitch .65 and neck yaw .15 added. Baby riding Kangaroo adds head-50deg/neck+120deg and headZ-2.
No explicit death/hurt suppression around these model overlays. This establishes selected code ordering only, not exact Citadel numeric final pose.
entry_and_recovery: Entity increments/decrements sit/stand/move/pouch progress in unit steps bounded0..5. prev values captured before each tick update. Moving uses full deltaMovement.lengthSqr>.03, not only horizontal speed.

Natural sit server-only: NO_ANIMATION,command!=1,notstanding/notsitting,random1/1500; timed sit500..849. Target/standing cancels non-forced sit; forced sit/tame/notvehicle reasserts sitting. Random stand branch has no explicit client guard.
Stand max usually75..124; attack setAnimation sets standing true and maxStandTime30(kick) or15(punch), does not reset standingTime. isVehicle renews standing and max25 each tick.
Sitting/eating travel clears navigation path when present and sends Vec3.ZERO to super.travel. Does not prove existing velocity is erased or all environmental movement prevented.

Grass eat entry server:notmoving/NO_ANIMATION/not sitting/not standing, grass below plus random180 or injured40. Keys5+5+5+reset5=20, declared30; heal6/grass->dirt tests tick20. At20 local clip target offsets reset, but live overlays still apply.

Kick keys5 windup+2hold+5extension+3reset=15; entity hit checktick8 occurs within extension, not fully extended endpoint12. Punch keys3+3+reset5=11 vs entity13; hit6 at attack target endpoint. These are source thresholds, not collision/game timing certification.

Hit checks require current target, line of sight and distance<target.width+self.width+1; calls knockback and doHurtTarget. Block outside explicit server-only inventory/eat section: do not claim this file proves server-only effects.

KangarooAIMelee begins only when current animation==NO_ANIMATION; kick random or hand-aware punch. Water-grab VisualFlag1 is a separate posture overlay; stop resets flag0, water malus and water counters, not all model channels.

Entity.setAnimation assigns currentAnimation and stand flags only; it does not itself reset animationTick. updateAnimations is called last in tick. Exact external Citadel replacement/end behavior remains unclosed; do not reuse Grottol LLibrary zero-tick replacement conclusions.

Selected subclass hurt handles equipment after super.hurt, no custom hurt/death animation. Save fields sitting/forced/standing/command and equipment indices+inventory; local counters,jump phase,animation tick/clip not explicitly saved here. Ancestor reload semantics not closed.
jump_lifecycle: startJumping when !sitting OR inwater sets jumping true,duration16,ticks0. jumpFromGround broadcasts event1 server-side; client event1 also sets duration16/ticks0.
tick advances ticks until duration then clears jumpTicks,duration and setJumping(false); getJumpCompletion=(ticks+partial)/duration else0. Exact frame scheduling not validated.

customServerAiStep landing transition calls setJumping(false), updateMoveTypeDuration(2 ifspeed<2 else1), disables jumpControl; approach/navigation/target can trigger nextjump. No terrain IK or explicit foot/head ground sampling in selected model.
attachments: Held object layer consumes MAINHAND and isLeftHanded; follows root->body->chest->chosenArm; translates[0,.75,-.125], rotatesX-110/Y180,scale.8; display context selected left/right but renderItem mirror argument false for both. Object mesh/UV/texture out of scope.

Helmet anchor follows root/body/chest/neck/head; chestplate follows root/body/chest then copies arm positions/angles and sit-dependent offsets. Armor layer wrapper was historically excluded; no new separate credit.

Pouch layer follows root->body, not animated pouch node; localtranslate[0,1.12,-.3], Z180, Y(riderRot+180); renders passenger with static ModelKangaroo.renderOnlyHead=true then false. Normal return restores flag; exception is rethrown without finally in this selected path, cleanup on exception not proved.
RenderKangaroo.shouldRender suppresses baby passenger on Kangaroo in ordinary dispatch. Layer attempts separate passenger render; full dispatcher/ClientProxy suppression path unclosed.

AnimalAIRideParent locates alive-context adult sameclass empty passenger list, approaches every10 ticks, startsRiding atdistance<2. Entity.canAddPassenger also requires pouchTick0; shift inventory interaction ejects passengers and opens pouch indefinitely(-1), close sets10.

Young modelrender scaleswhole .5/head1.65 with childscale=true; renderOnlyHead branch neck pos[0,0,0], normalyoung render overwrites neckpos[0,2,-8] after setupAnim. Headscale restored1 after render; shouldScaleChildren remains true. Full reset-scale semantics not proved without exact dependency.

actual_visual_evidence.scope: existing static gray bind reconstruction front-oblique/side; no animation/texture/native proof
original128x128atlas: tan broad areas, darker nose/ear/underside zones; atlas alone is not textured model evidence; not copied into Dynasty

usable_method_not_copied: Use a coherent support-chain hierarchy and body-specific counterposes, rather than disconnected chest/limb boxes or human gait on a nonhuman body.
Audit real attachment matrices after all state overlays; ordinary idle screenshots cannot establish attack contact or juvenile riding alignment.
Separate declared clip lifetime from keyframe reset time and actual damage tick; do not cut/re-time Dynasty skills from external examples.
